name: MyBatis SQL Visualizer
description: Renders MyBatis mapper XML, annotation SQL, iBatis 2.x, MyBatis-Plus wrappers and SQL logs into executable SQL, and checks a statement before it reaches a database. Every result carries exact/partial/unresolved confidence; unresolved never produces SQL.
notes: package still carries the pre-rename id songrenshuo.mybatis-plus-sql-visualizer (built 2026-11-29); the next release rebuilds it under the new id. Requires re-approving capabilities if the plugin was linked before this version: the manifest now declares events as required.
